title: About us: independent Bitcoin hub since 2018 | Virtuse
og_title: About Virtuse: an independent hub for Bitcoin services
description: Virtuse is an independent comparison hub for Bitcoin services, founded in 2018 by Rastislav Vasilisin. Bitcoin-only. We don't hold client funds or keys.
lead: Virtuse compares Bitcoin services from partners and links you to them. You buy, store and borrow on the partner's own platform, under its licence. Virtuse is operated by Virtuse Wealth Management, a.s.
t1_p: Virtuse started as a digital asset and commodity platform.
t2_p: Virtuse dropped everything except Bitcoin and became a Bitcoin-only exchange.
t3_p: Virtuse became an independent comparison hub for Bitcoin services.
t4_p: We compare partners for buying, custody, loans, mining, tax and more. Virtuse no longer operates an exchange and does not hold client funds or keys.
founder_bio: Rastislav (Ras) Vasilisin founded Virtuse in 2018 and has led it from a digital asset platform to a Bitcoin-only exchange and, today, an independent hub for Bitcoin services. He writes the weekly Virtuse Brief and the column Ras Vasilisin's Take, and publishes on HackerNoon.
v1_p: We cover Bitcoin services only. No altcoins and no tokens.
v2_p: We don't hold client funds or keys and we don't execute orders. Every service runs on the partner's own platform.
v3_p: Partner Finder orders partners by fixed rules based on your answers, not by the referral fees some partners pay us.
name_p1: Our name is inspired by virtù, a concept introduced by Niccolò Machiavelli. To him, virtù wasn't about conventional morality. It was about strength, control and the ability to shape your own circumstances.
name_p2: We see Bitcoin in the same way: money you can hold and control yourself, without asking anyone's permission.
name_p3: That is the idea behind the name.
vet_intro: Before a partner appears on Virtuse, we look at the same points. They help you compare. They are not a guarantee.
k1_p: Which licence or registration the partner holds and in which register it is listed.
k2_p: Whether you can withdraw your Bitcoin to your own wallet and who holds it while it is on the platform.
k3_p: How long the partner has operated and what is publicly known about its history.
k4_p: Whether fees are published and how they compare with other partners.
vet_licence: Each partner's licence is shown in Partner Finder with its official register source and the date we checked it.
x_stack_p: Plan regular buys and compare fees.
x_loan_p: Compare selling with borrowing against Bitcoin.
x_tax_p: Bitcoin tax rules and inheritance readiness.
x_ret_p: Can your Bitcoin fund your retirement?
cfo_text: Verdict is free; the fee audit comes with Virtuse CFO. Paid plans, once they open: €9/month or €90/year.
